newsitem.title: USA: Scholastic sees Q3 loss, lower '97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Scholastic sees Q3 loss, lower '97 profit.

text.p: Scholastic Corp said Thursday that for its third quarter, ending February 28, the company expects a loss of between $0.70 and $0.80 per share, which includes $0.50 per share to cover a $13 million pre-tax special charge consisting of a reserve for anticipated additional retail book returns.
Third-quarter profits a year ago were $0.55 per share.
The company said it also expects its earnings per share for its fiscal year ending May 31, 1997, to be between $1.45 and $1.60, compared to $1.97 in the prior fiscal year.
